questions.question: In the electromagnetic spectrum infrared occupy a place between:

questions.question: Commonest embolus originates from:

questions.question: The duration of normal cardiac cycle is:

questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/Pg. 297

questions.question: In rheumatic arthritis the pathology starts in:
questions.explanation: Pathology in rheumatoid arthritis begins in the synovium.

questions.question: The mallet finger results from injury to:

options.D: Extensor tendons of the terminal phalanx of finger

questions.question: The hip musculature involves several muscle groups for different actions. Hip abduction takes place with nerve innervation from the superior gluteal nerve. Which muscles compose the hip abductor group?

options.B: Gluteus medius, gluteus minimus, tensor fasciae latae

questions.explanation: The hip abductors are gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and tensor fasciae latae (superior gluteal nerve).

questions.question: A woman's pulmonary and cardiovascular systems are altered physiologically during pregnancy. Which of the following would a physical therapist expect to observe when examining a pregnant woman?

options.A: Decreased oxygen reserve ad decreased stroke volume
options.B: Increased oxygen reserve and increased stroke volume
options.C: Decreased oxygen reserve and increased cardiac output
options.D: Decreased stroke volume and decreased cardiac output

questions.explanation: Pregnancy reduces oxygen reserve (lower FRC) and raises cardiac output.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)

questions.question: Most common dislocation of the hip is:
questions.explanation: Posterior dislocation is by far the commonest hip dislocation.

questions.question: A group of therapists conduct a research study which examines the effect of functional keen bracing on speed and agility. As part of the study the therapists determine measures of central tendency for each measured test. Which of the following would not be considered a measure of central tendency?
questions.explanation: Range is a measure of dispersion, not central tendency.

questions.question: A patient status post motor vehicle accident is treated using skeletal traction. What bone when fractured is often associated with this type of traction?

questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Musculoskeletal Condition

questions.question: A therapist measures the vertical leap of members of a basketball team. The therapist then calculates the difference between the highest and lowest values in the distribution. What measure of variability has the therapist determined?
questions.explanation: Range is the difference between the highest and lowest values.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Research Methods for Clinical Therapists/Hicks/4th Ed./Pg. 54

questions.question: A child with athetoid cerebral palsy is referred to physical therapy. Which of the following characteristics 22 would a physical therapist typically identify when examining the child?

options.A: Continuous low tone and intermittent tonic spasms
options.B: Small range movements with full control within the range
options.C: Disorganized movement with fluctuating muscle tone
options.D: Little to no influence from tonic neck reflexes

questions.explanation: Athetoid cerebral palsy shows disorganised movement with fluctuating tone.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.subject: Physiotherapy in Neurosciences

questions.question: The earth pin of the plug socket is larger as:

options.A: It allows one-way entry of the socket
options.B: It allows the earth pin to enter first and come out last

questions.question: A patient is referred to physical therapy after sustaining a complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament. The patient's ligament injury is best described as a:
questions.explanation: A complete ligament tear is a grade III sprain.

questions.question: A therapist develops a treatment program for a patient diagnosed with cystic fibrosis. Which of the following treatment activities would be the most essential to improve ventilation?

questions.question: Fall on outstretched hand may lead to fracture of:

questions.question: For immediate management of soft tissue injury acronym RICE stands for:

options.A: Rubbing, instant heat, clean and elevation

questions.question: In high steppage gait there is paralysis of:

questions.question: The ratio of chest compression to manual ventilation for a single rescuer in CPR is:

questions.question: A physician places a patient with moderate hypertension on diuretics. What is the most serious side effect of diuretics? Research and Analysis
questions.explanation: The most serious effects of diuretics are fluid depletion and electrolyte imbalance (e.g. hypokalaemia).

questions.question: A patient sustains a deep laceration on the right anterior thigh after stumbling and falling in a modality cart. The therapist's most immediate response should be to:
